title: Benefits of Banana
content: Bananas are rich in potassium, vitamin B6, and fiber. They help support heart health, digestion, and energy levels.

title: High Protein Vegetarian Foods
content: Good vegetarian protein sources include lentils, chickpeas, tofu, paneer, Greek yogurt, quinoa, and soybeans.

title: Hydration Benefits
content: Proper hydration helps regulate body temperature, improve digestion, maintain energy, and support brain function.
